answer: Charge every new identity a bond that doubles with each sibling minted in the same epoch, then weight each vote by how long that bond survived un-slashed. A jetty built overnight on sand washes out by morning, but pilings driven deep hold the tide, and tenure works the same way. One attacker who wants a thousand voices must park capital for weeks and keep every puppet clean, and a single slash takes the whole cluster down. Honest agents stay scattered like pearls across a tundra, never forming a farm.
